这件事成了地狱门，一个最大的痛，也是教众一个最大的疑问，更成为江湖上，最大的疑团。

“你觉得我该怎么处理这些人？”罗生扫了一眼名单之后，微微点了点头，淡淡的说道。

大公是爵位的巅峰，再往上就是造反。贞德大公不希望阿索门德造反，只希望他能守成。

也许是宁云舒脸上的惊讶取悦了带他们来的修者，他误以为宁云舒的惊讶，是始人类对他能力的惊叹，在等待的过程中，便以高傲的姿态、多嘴了几句。

听到陈诲这么说，这个叫着陈念的道长，脸色顿时便塌下来了，不由冷冷的看着了陈诲。

巫师们只会感到无聊、沮丧、麻木、有气无力，诸如此类较为负面的情绪。

“第一大学设立新学院一百年都没有一次。”郑清幽幽的插了一嘴——他虽然在抄作业，却一直竖着耳朵，捕捉几位同伴的谈话。

这声音绵长悠远，虽然从山洞里传出来，响亮的令人十分难受，却也没有让人感觉到怪异。

虽然罗生情况特殊，得到了两位传奇大师的认可，但如果在没有亲身接触到传奇大师本人的时候，就冒然做出选择，拒绝一位传奇大师。往轻了说是草率，往重了说，其实是对传奇大师极大的不尊重。

但是可惜，这样庞大的一股力量，单凭霍林德，根本无法全部动用。

虽然对于那些大名而言，只有本家的武士和那些豢养的武士才是自己的真正武装力量，可是领地内过多青壮力损失也是对他们实力的削弱。

This incident has become the Gate of Hell, the biggest pain, the biggest question for the church members, and the biggest mystery in the world.

"How do you think I should deal with these people?" Luo Sheng glanced at the list, nodded slightly, and said calmly.

The Grand Duke is the pinnacle of the title, and anything above that is rebellion.The Archduke Joan of Arc did not want Asholmende to rebel, but only hoped that he could maintain the status quo.

Perhaps the surprise on Ning Yunshu's face pleased the cultivator who brought them here. He mistakenly thought that Ning Yunshu's surprise was the original human's admiration for his abilities. While waiting, he spoke a few words in a arrogant manner.

Hearing what Chen Hui said, the Taoist priest named Chen Nian's face suddenly fell, and he couldn't help but look at Chen Hui coldly.

Wizards will only feel bored, frustrated, numb, weak, and other more negative emotions.

"The First University has established a new college only once in a hundred years." Zheng Qing interjected quietly - although he was copying homework, he kept his ears open to catch the conversations of several companions.

The sound was long and distant. Although it came from the cave and was very loud and uncomfortable, it did not make people feel weird.

Although Luo Sheng was in a special situation and was recognized by two legendary masters, he would have made a rash choice and rejected a legendary master without having personal contact with the legendary master himself.To put it mildly, it is rash, but to put it more seriously, it is actually a huge disrespect for the legendary master.

But unfortunately, such a huge force cannot be fully utilized by Hollind alone.

Although for those daimyo, only the samurai of their own family and the samurai they support are their real armed forces, the loss of too many young and strong men in the territory also weakens their strength.
